run_bench_hnsw_cli: run the HNSW benchmark tool via CLI with configurable M, threads, and efSearch parameters
run_run_on_dataset: run an HNSW index benchmark on a given FAISS Dataset and collect performance counters
run_run_synthetic: run an HNSW benchmark on a synthetic dataset with specified dimensionality and vector counts
review_timed_execution: review the timed_execution context manager that measures wall, user, and system time in microseconds
refactor_accumulate_perf_counter: refactor accumulate_perf_counter to add system time tracking alongside wall and user time counters
